# SUPERMISSION

> SUPERMISSION is the AI-powered DeFi terminal on Base, Polygon, and Robinhood Chain. One chat, every trade. Swap tokens, provide liquidity, lend, earn yield, trade prediction markets, and analyze wallets — all from a single conversational interface. No app-hopping. No complexity. You type, AI executes on-chain.

Website: https://supermission.fun
Full details: https://supermission.fun/llms-full.txt

## What SUPERMISSION Does

SUPERMISSION replaces 10+ DeFi apps with one AI chat terminal. Users describe what they want in plain English, and the AI agent (DELPHI) handles the complexity — resolving tokens, finding best routes, computing optimal ranges, and executing on-chain. Users just click Confirm.

### Trade
- Swap any token across 40+ chains via LI.FI aggregation
- Bridge assets cross-chain in one command
- Provide liquidity on Uniswap V3 with automated range optimization
- Trade prediction markets powered by Polymarket with AI signals

### Earn
- Deposit into Morpho MetaMorpho vaults, Aave V3, Compound III
- AI scans 1,000+ yield pools in real-time to find the best opportunities
- One-click yield strategies with risk-adjusted recommendations

### Analyze
- Token research with safety scores, honeypot detection, holder analysis
- Full wallet intelligence — ERC-20 tokens, NFTs, DeFi positions, risk assessment
- Smart money tracking via Nansen — see what whales and institutions are buying
- Prediction market signals and analysis

## Key Features

- **Zero gas fees** — Supermission absorbs gas, users never pay
- **Email-to-wallet** — Sign up with email, trade in 30 seconds via Privy embedded wallets
- **On-chain settlement** — Every transaction verifiable on Basescan
- **Multi-chain** — Supports Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and Robinhood Chain
- **Gasless execution** — Privy-sponsored transactions for embedded wallets

## Technology

- Built on Base (Ethereum L2, Chain ID 8453), Polygon (Chain ID 137), and Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum-based Ethereum L2 for tokenized real-world assets, Chain ID 4663)
- Payments in USDC
- DeFi integrations: LI.FI (40+ chains), Uniswap V3, Aave V3, Compound III, Morpho MetaMorpho
- Market data: Nansen, CoinGecko, CryptoCompare, Chainlink
- Prediction markets: Polymarket CLOB
- Wallet: Privy embedded wallets with email signup

## FAQ

Q: What is SUPERMISSION?
A: An AI-powered DeFi terminal on Base, Polygon, and Robinhood Chain. One chat interface to swap, lend, LP, earn yield, trade prediction markets, and analyze wallets. No app-hopping required.

Q: How does it work?
A: You type what you want in plain English (e.g., "swap 100 USDC to WETH on Base"). The AI agent DELPHI handles routing, pricing, and execution. You click Confirm. Done.

Q: What blockchain does it use?
A: Base (Ethereum L2) and Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum-based Ethereum L2 for tokenized real-world assets). Also supports Ethereum and Polygon for swaps and analysis.

Q: Is it free?
A: Free to use. Zero gas fees for embedded wallet users. Trading involves USDC for DeFi and prediction market operations.

Q: What DeFi protocols does it support?
A: LI.FI (swaps across 40+ chains), Uniswap V3 (LP), Aave V3, Compound III, Morpho MetaMorpho (lending/yield), and Polymarket (prediction markets).
